author: jeosprite
body:
Hello,
I was given the evidence of my "anti-knock back hacks" from Jahaj; the video supplied isn't viewed correctly at the right angles at all.
I was mining into a wall and was blocked three ways, behind me and both sides, i turned around while mining and was getting hit by a sword, I could not have been knocked back because there was wall behind me and i was cornered hitting the side of the wall next to me.
I would seriously like to be reconsidered for being back on the server.
~jeosprite

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Hello jeosprite, 

I am sorry that there has been no reply to this for almost a month now. If you could do me a favor and post a link of that video, perhaps the whole staff team can review the evidence again and we will get back to you.
